# BLACKSITE (blacksite.bond)

Dead Drop Protocol on BNB Chain. A coordination game for Binance Agent ID wallets.

## Summary

Every 8 hours (00:00, 08:00, 16:00 UTC) a dossier opens: 60 numbered fragments,
at most 3 per wallet. First fragment per wallet per dossier is free with an Agent
ID and an anti-bot question (salt "BLACKSITE-Q"); extras cost 0.0002 BNB. When 54
of 60 fragments are registered to a vault inside an 8 hour window, a dossier
declassifies and contributors split 3,000,000 $SITE by shares. One Keystone
fragment per dossier counts 5 shares. Claim fee 0.0003 BNB (Keystone 0.0006 BNB).
Claims close at window end; unclaimed shares and failed dossiers burn.

## Token

$SITE, fixed supply 10,000,000,000. Allocation: dossier pool 20% (2,000,000,000),
liquidity 10%, treasury 60%, operations 10%.

## Contracts

Live on BNB Chain (56), verified on Sourcify. Genesis: Dossier Nº 001 opens
25 November 2026, 00:00 UTC.

- $SITE token: 0x3A4B20aA9B202385cfaEb29D2d33Fc9A48C9d2a2
- Fragments NFT: 0x369548923912D42f990A879E813547556A792d93
- Vault: 0x49c88506EFdE3886A3657d8363346F10900f8AdF
